attribution.creator: Staatliches Institut für Musikforschung (SIMPK)
attribution.instrument: Johann Gottlob Horn clavichord, Dresden, circa 1793

source_samples.sample_set_hash_algorithm: sort unique archive-root-relative UTF-8 POSIX paths; concatenate lowercase '<sha256>  <path>\n>'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes

playback_mapping.description: Preserve the recorded native octave; do not pitch the WAV data up by 12 semitones.

content_uniqueness.hash_scope: complete decoded PCM payload plus sample rate, channel count, bit depth, and decoded frame count
content_uniqueness.interpretation: Each timbre/key/round-robin group exposes 3 upstream velocity-zone paths with identical PCM, so the archive provides 1 unique recorded velocity through 3 mapping zones, 2 round robins, and 2 timbres.

project_modifications: Repair the single known unescaped XML label only while parsing.
Convert SIMPK interleaved PCM-point boundaries to inclusive SFZ audio-frame boundaries.
Expose the upstream lupe and reso groups as normal and resonance articulations.
Map upstream rootNote 40-102 to the measured native sounding roots 28-90 instead of pitching the recordings up by one octave.
Retain the 3 upstream velocity zones for deterministic mapping compatibility while documenting that their PCM is identical inside every timbre/key/round-robin group.
Apply a frozen per-sample fine-tuning table relative to the actual roots; original WAV bytes remain unchanged.
